title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.6 (Peaked November 24, 2026 at 00:41 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 315 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Pretty quiet out there. 🌞

A large central coronal-hole-like region stands out today, while sunspot coverage remains sparse and coronal activity looks generally modest.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
